372.start: and if thou thinkest any thing further necessary,
alternatives: Start after mayst or repair to mayest, rejected
372.reason: Greek καὶ εἰ continues Nicolaus' advice; full canonical and published interval, predecessor and closing quote agree. Three inherited mayst forms limit prefix matching, without changing the boundary. Keep the connective and all original punctuation.

373.start: Now as they came to Cesarea,
alternatives: Start after Cesarea or change name, rejected
373.reason: The complete English arrival and public suspense correspond to Greek Ὡς δ᾽ ἦλθεν εἰς Καισάρειαν, after advice has closed in372. Cesarea versus Caesarea explains skipped prefix only. Preserve existing num373 and exact spelling.

400.start: yet cannot their father be thought worthy excuse,
alternatives: Automatic candidate favor; before yet, rejected
400.reason: Greek ὁ μέντοι πατὴρ turns from blame of the sons to the father's impiety. The published cut starts yet; the canonical omission of of in worthy excuse caused back-counted anchoring to include favor; from399. Move forward to yet and retain the original omission. The full400 accusations and401 discussion remain distinct.
